input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: Section 21 is structurally sound: the cap is expressly mutual (21.1), indirect and consequential damages are mutually excluded with a helpful direct-damages list (21.2), and "Excluded Claims" (21.3) keeps confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap. The failure is the cap base: "Fees" is defined at 1.5 as only the "Implementation Fee", which 1.6 fixes as a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form, and 21.1 narrows it further to that first Order Form, so recurring subscription and services charges are excluded and the cap is an illusory USD 12,000 — below the six-month floor and in walk-away territory. The redline resets limb (a) to fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and adds the USD 1,000,000 limb, and confirms in 21.3 that Customer's payment obligations are not damages while preserving the existing "undisputed" and "conforming Services" qualifiers as an inclusive example. Mutuality, the damages exclusion and every carve-out are untouched.

ops.oldText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's payment obligations, including its obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services, are not damages and are not limited by this Section.

Mutuality, the damages exclusion and the Excluded Claims carve-outs are unchanged.
proposal.summary: 21.1 cap basis reset to greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim or USD 1,000,000; 21.3 confirms Customer's payment obligations are not damages
